data.question_intent: Seeking explanation for change in duration targeting and confidence in the change
data.question_quote: I think today, in [your] guidance, it's the first time you've pointed us to the seven-year swap rate from the five-year swap rate on the [structural] hedge book. And could you talk about, is there a change in kind of the duration targeting there and what gives you the confidence to make that change? You're looking at deposit betas, etc?
data.answer_quote: We actually extended the length of the hedge last year and taking it from roughly three years to three and a half and that's why the seven-year swap rates becomes the most relevant rate. And what we were observing was really that the customer and client lives were lengthening out and we were getting more confidence around that. So, it's purely a reflection of that change.
